description: This file manages a task registry system, including task creation, updates, delivery, cancellation, and persistence. It handles task lifecycle events, observer notifications, and integrates with external modules for messaging and flow control.

classes.name: ParentFlowLinkError
classes.description: Custom error class for parent flow linking issues, with specific error codes and optional details.

methods.name: isParentFlowLinkError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a ParentFlowLinkError.

methods.name: ensureTaskRegistryReady
methods.description: Ensures the task registry is initialized and ready for operations.

methods.name: createTaskRecord
methods.description: Creates a new task record, handling existing tasks and initializing task properties.

methods.name: listTaskRecords
methods.description: Returns all task records sorted by newest first.

methods.name: getTaskRegistrySummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of all tasks in the registry.

methods.name: getTaskRegistrySnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current task registry state.

methods.name: getTaskById
methods.description: Retrieves a task by its ID.

methods.name: findTaskByRunId
methods.description: Finds the preferred task associated with a specific run ID.

methods.name: resolveTaskForLookupToken
methods.description: Resolves a task based on a lookup token, checking by ID, run ID, or related session key.

methods.name: deleteTaskRecordById
methods.description: Deletes a task record by its ID, cleaning up indexes and emitting events.

methods.name: resetTaskRegistryForTests
methods.description: Resets the task registry to an empty state, optionally persisting the reset.

methods.name: resetTaskRegistryDeliveryRuntimeForTests
methods.description: Resets the delivery runtime override for testing purposes.

methods.name: setTaskRegistryDeliveryRuntimeForTests
methods.description: Sets a custom delivery runtime for testing.

methods.name: maybeDeliverTaskTerminalUpdate
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a terminal update for a task if conditions are met.

methods.name: maybeDeliverTaskStateChangeUpdate
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a state change update for a task if conditions are met.
